terbaru.judul: Neural-Parameterized Cellular Automata for Wildfire Spread
terbaru.pelajaran: To address this weakness, we introduce a hybrid deep-learning parameterized Probabilistic Cellular Automata (CA) framework implemented in JAX.

terbaru.judul: Embedding Finite Functions into Low-Degree Polynomial Functions over Commutative Rings
terbaru.pelajaran: A function $f \colon X^k \to X$ on a finite set embeds into a polynomial of total degree $d$ over a commutative ring $R$ if there is an injection $j \colon X \to R$ and a polynomial $g$ of total degree at most $d$ with $j \circ f = g \circ j^k$, where $j^k$ applies $j$ in each coordinate.

terbaru.judul: Dynamics in a Low-Rank Separable Field Cellular Automaton
terbaru.pelajaran: Here, we introduce a Separable-Field Cellular Automaton (SFCA), in which conventional local-neighborhood interactions are replaced by updates governed by a normalized global coupling field.

terbaru.judul: Three-dimensional Fundamental Diagrams of Five-neighbor Particle Cellular Automata
terbaru.pelajaran: We analyze five-neighbor particle cellular automata whose conventional two-dimensional fundamental diagrams are multivalued, but whose mean flow is uniquely determined by introducing a second density.

terbaru.judul: Thermalization with Gaussian Quantum Cellular Automata
terbaru.pelajaran: We study the long-time dynamics of many-body bosonic lattice systems under translation-invariant Gaussian quantum cellular automata.

terbaru.judul: Counting number-conserving cellular automata with radius 1
terbaru.pelajaran: This text is also a program that computes the number of one-dimensional number-conserving cellular automata with radius 1.

terbaru.judul: Agnosiophobia in a virtual agent: behavioral and dynamical architecture in Lenia
terbaru.pelajaran: To evaluate the behavior of patterns in Lenia, we introduce regions into their environment from which no sensory information is available - in effect, making creatures blind to parts of their surroundings.

terbaru.judul: Comonadic Morphophonology: A Compositional Framework for Context-Dependent Morphological Rules in Finnish
terbaru.pelajaran: We present the first framework where each morphophonological rule is a function from a focused local context to a single output segment -- the type of a local rule familiar from cellular automata -- and where length-changing rules compose as coKleisli arrows of a comonad.

terbaru.judul: Stationary Measures and Mean Flux Depending on Multiple Conserved Quantities in a Stochastic Cellular Automaton
terbaru.pelajaran: We analyze a stochastic 5-neighbor cellular automaton with several conserved quantities, including the particle density.

terbaru.judul: Measuring Prediction Uncertainty in Neural Cellular Automata
terbaru.pelajaran: Here, we study uncertainty estimation for NCA-based medical image segmentation without modifying the underlying architecture or retraining the model.
